shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin stabilizes around $77,000 with some altcoin gains, though overall market sentiment remains in "Extreme Fear".
Rising hopes for a US-Iran peace deal act as a positive catalyst for risk assets including cryptocurrencies.
Hawkish Federal Reserve stance and persistent net outflows from US spot Bitcoin ETFs weigh on investor sentiment.
US Senate advances the Digital Asset Market CLARITY Act, and Japan prepares to recognize foreign-issued stablecoins as legal payment.
CryptoQuant data indicates Bitcoin's "Apparent Demand" has dropped to its lowest level since early 2026, indicating weakening structural demand.
